To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the reform of physical educaiton curriculum in basic education should be based on the people-oriented principle, and the value choices of curriculum design, implementation and evaluation should be integrated with each other.
the three core links of physical education curriculum reform in basic education in the new century should realize the organic combination of social,professional and individual values.
the value choices in the core links of physical education curriculum reform are the key to the success of the reform.

the value orientation of the three core links in reform of physical education curriculums in basic education in new China.
the value choices in the reform process of physical education curriculum.

the value choices of the three core links in curriculum in the reform of basic education physical education curriculum in China in the 21st century, and provides a new idea for the reform of physical curriculum in China in new century.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the reform of physical educations curriculum in basic education should take the development and health of students as its core, and realize the integration of social standard, disciplinary standard and student standard.
value choices in the reform should be made in the direction of humanization,scientificity,integration,practicality,openness and development.
the value choices in the reform physical education curriculum in China in the 21st century are to be people oriented,health first,student centered,curriculum oriented and development focused.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

physical education curriculum reform is an important part of the curriculum reform in basic education in the new century;the reform should be carried out from the aspects of curriculum design,implementation and evaluation;it should also be based on the value choices in curriculum reform.
the reform of physical educations curriculum in basic education should be based on value choices.

we should realize the organic combination of value choices in curriculum reform,make value choices in curriculum design,implementation and evaluation,so as to realize the organic combination between value choice and curriculum reform.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the three core links in physical education curriculum reform in basic education in the new century all have to face new value choices.
the three core links in curriculum development should be integrated in the new century,which will provide a new direction for the reform of physical educations curriculum in basic education.
